content.text: The stray `i++` in the `\\` case skips an extra character.

content.content: The file /tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-411600908/acap-bench-4126858370/lexer/lexer.go has been updated successfully.

content.text:
The root cause was in `readString` in `lexer/lexer.go`. The `\\` escape case wrote the backslash and then ran an extra `i++`, so the loop skipped the character after the escape. That's why `"C:\\temp"` lost its `t`, and why `"x\\"` swallowed the closing quote and reported an unterminated string. The same lexer bug caused the failures in the `query` parser tests.

I removed the extra `i++`. `go test ./...` now passes everywhere. `cmd/inventory` has no test files.
